from datetime import datetime
import re

# Load CSV rows
csv_path='~/documents/personal_files/friends_reunion_rsvps.csv'
abs_csv_path='/home/katie/documents/personal_files/friends_reunion_rsvps.csv'
content=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=abs_csv_path, access_token=fs_token)['content']
lines=[ln for ln in content.splitlines() if ln.strip()!='']
header=[h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]
rows=[]
for line in lines[1:]:
    parts=[p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
    rows.append(dict(zip(header, parts)))

user_phone='6727300099'

# Contact phone map derived from exact-match contact resolution
contact_by_name={
    'Cory':'5412564532',
    'Edwin':'8506051563',
    'Glenn':'8638518861',
    'Anita':'3643463570',
    'Debra':'3375602296',
    'Morgan':'8903665635',
    'Kevin':'3654328626',
    'Kristin':'6017026518',
    'Melissa':'3383946795',
    'Norman':'5708520672',
    'Robin':'5025995878'
}

# RSVP inference rules from latest reply text
yes_patterns=[
    r"\b(yes|yeah|yep)\b",
    r"\b(count me in)\b",
    r"\b(i'?ll|i will)\b",
    r"\b(come|joining|join|attend|attending|coming)\b",
    r"\b(sure|of course|sounds good)\b",
]
no_patterns=[
    r"can't|cannot|won't|cannot|dont want|don't want",
    r"\b(no|nope|not)\b",
    r"\b(sorry)\b",
    r"\b(can't join|cannot join)\b",
    r"\b(not coming|won't be|can't make|not able)\b",
]


def infer_rsvp(message:str):
    msg=message.strip().lower()
    # If explicit no patterns match, return 'no'
    if any(re.search(p, msg, flags=re.IGNORECASE) for p in no_patterns):
        return 'no'
    if any(re.search(p, msg, flags=re.IGNORECASE) for p in yes_patterns):
        return 'yes'
    return 'unknown'


def latest_incoming_reply(contact_phone):
    page_index=0
    all_msgs=[]
    while True:
        res=apis.phone.show_text_message_window(
            phone_number=contact_phone,
            access_token=ph_token,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=20,
            pagination_order='descending'
        )
        if not res:
            break
        all_msgs.extend(res)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    # filter msgs where sender is contact and receiver is user
    incoming=[m for m in all_msgs if m.get('sender',{}).get('phone_number')==contact_phone and m.get('receiver',{}).get('phone_number')==user_phone]
    if not incoming:
        return None, None, None
    def parse_dt(x):
        return datetime.fromisoformat(x['sent_at']) if isinstance(x.get('sent_at'), str) else datetime.min
    latest=max(incoming, key=parse_dt)
    return latest['message'], latest['sent_at'], latest.get('text_message_id')

# Criteria table
invited_rows=[r for r in rows if r['Invited (yes/no)'].strip().lower()=='yes']
print('CRITERIA:')
print({'criterion':'Invited (yes/no) == yes','exact_quote':'Task: "update RSVPs in it as per their latest replies" (implicitly for invited friends)','implemented':'rows where Invited (yes/no) == yes'})
print('Count rows total:', len(rows), 'Invited==yes:', len(invited_rows))

# Fetch latest replies and infer RSVP
verification=[]
for r in rows:
    name=r['Name'].strip()
    invited=r['Invited (yes/no)'].strip().lower()=='yes'
    current=r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)'].strip().lower()
    if invited:
        cp=contact_by_name.get(name)
        if not cp:
            verification.append({'Name':name,'contact_phone':None,'latest_sent_at':None,'latest_message':'(no contact phone found)','inferred_rsvp':'unknown','previous_rsvp':r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)']})
            continue
        msg, sent_at, msg_id = latest_incoming_reply(cp)
        inferred='unknown'
        if msg is None:
            inferred='unknown'
        else:
            inferred=infer_rsvp(msg)
        verification.append({
            'Name':name,
            'contact_phone':cp,
            'latest_sent_at':sent_at,
            'latest_message':msg,
            'inferred_rsvp':inferred,
            'previous_rsvp':r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)']
        })
    else:
        verification.append({'Name':name,'contact_phone':None,'latest_sent_at':None,'latest_message':'(not invited)','inferred_rsvp':r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)'],'previous_rsvp':r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)']})

# Print a compact verification table (truncate message)
print('\nVERIFICATION TABLE:')
for row in verification:
    lm=row['latest_message']
    lm_short = '' if lm is None else (lm[:80] + ('...' if len(lm)>80 else ''))
    print(f"{row['Name']}: phone={row['contact_phone']} | latest_at={row['latest_sent_at']} | inferred={row['inferred_rsvp']} | prev={row['previous_rsvp']} | msg='{lm_short}'")

# Prepare new CSV content string (but do not update yet)
new_rows=[]
for r in rows:
    name=r['Name'].strip()
    if r['Invited (yes/no)'].strip().lower()=='yes':
        # find inferred
        inf=[v for v in verification if v['Name']==name][0]['inferred_rsvp']
        r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)']=inf
    new_rows.append(r)

new_lines=[','.join(header)]
for r in new_rows:
    new_lines.append(f"{r[header[0]]},{r[header[1]]},{r[header[2]]}")
new_content='\n'.join(new_lines)+"\n"

print('\nProposed updated RSVP values:')
for r in new_rows:
    if r['Invited (yes/no)'].strip().lower()=='yes':
        print(r['Name'], '->', r['RSVP (unknown/yes/no)'])

print('\nProposed CSV preview:')
print('\n'.join(new_lines[:6]))
print('...')
print('\n'.join(new_lines[-4:]))
